notes.title: 0.20.0 Update
notes.notes:
Update is here!
This update primarily focuses on in-game UI, sound effects, as well as updated visual presentations and interaction rules.

Improvements

Added previews for more characters.
Added exploration animation effects on the map.
Added a visual effect for level-ups, preventing missed Talent selections.
Updated card border styles.
Updated border styles for Talents and Relics.
Updated styles for Talent, Spellbook, and Loot options.
Updated action button styles and added prompt effects when no actions are available.
Updated style of current location indicator on the map.
Fixed conflicting state issues between multiple hero filter buttons in the Archive interface.
Fixed Archive not correctly recording super effects of Relics.
 Fixed game occasionally freezing on loading screens caused by asynchronous loading.


Plan

 Focus on bug fixes and optimizations during Steam Festivals.

notes.title: 0.19.0 Update
notes.notes:
Update is here!
The Archive feature has now been added to the game. Here you can view all unlocked Cards, learned Talents, and discovered Relics.

Changes

 Added the Archive feature.


Improvements

 Updated layout and style of the title interface.
 Optimized loading speed when entering the game scenario for the first time.


Plan

 Preparations for upcoming Steam Festivals.

notes.title: 0.18.0 Update
notes.notes:
Update is here!
Primarily new events and some experience optimizations. On the selection interface, you can now more conveniently view hints related to Cards, Relics, and Talents. The Archive update will arrive in a few days.

Changes

 Added two new map events.


Improvements

 Added guidance related to enemies with Armor.
 Added an animation effect when obtaining Relics to show which new Relic was acquired.
 Enemies marked as minions will immediately surrender after their leader dies.
 Untargeted cards in hand can now be canceled by dragging them back to the hand, in addition to right-click cancellation.
 Added hover tooltips for cards in the deck viewing interface.
 Added relevant hints for Relics in the Relic selection interface.
 Added relevant hints for Talents in the Talent selection interface.


Plan

 Archive System
 Preparations for upcoming Steam Festivals

notes.title: 0.17.0 Update
notes.notes:
The update is here!
The second character is now available - simply complete one game with the first character to unlock it.
This character plays a bit differently, requiring you to spot enemies before unleashing a swift and fierce assault.

Changes

 Added the second character: The Walker.
 Adjusted values for specific Relics that were missed in previous balance changes.


Improvements

 Fixed an issue where incomplete Chapter 1 quests weren't automatically abandoned when entering Chapter 2.
 Fixed event:gallery not triggering properly.
 Fixed card states not updating at round start when hand capacity was full.


Plan

 More Relics
 More Events
 Expanded Localization
 Archive System
 Preparations for upcoming Steam Festivals

notes.title: 0.15.0 Update
notes.notes:
The Update is Here!
This time we've brought more cards for the first character and two new map events.

Changes

Significant changes have been made to the first character's cards. Ongoing game saves will not be compatible—you will need to start a new run. Card unlock progress remains unaffected.
The second Ultimate Skill Card has been added. Maybe you'll want to try a different ultimate strategy.


Plans

 Maps for Chapter 2.

notes.title: 0.14.0 Update
notes.notes:
The first update has arrived!
It has been some time since the last demo release, and we have added some new content as well as made improvements to some existing content.

Localization 
Added English localization support. (primarily machine-translated; may contain inaccuracies. Please report issues!)

 Change 

 Mission Nodes are now added to the map! Accept and complete objectives.
 Combat Timer implemented - faster victories unlock more exploration opportunities.
 Stance Bar & Break System: Introduced "Break Value" for damage-dealing cards. Higher Break Value = faster stance accumulation!


Optimizations 

 Optimized the novice guidance in the combat section, with text prompts appearing in more appropriate positions and correspondingly shortening the guidance process.
 Added Stun Status Indicator for enemies. (never miss attack windows!)
 Adjusted a notoriously difficult mid-tier combat encounter - fighting two crabs was a bit too "skill-intensive" .
 Optional Boss/Mission Rewards now guaranteed to provide Legendary/Cursed Relics. (unless you already own them all [strike]which is currently impossible[/strike])
 Reworked Broodmother's Summoning Logic - two medium spiders attacking simultaneously was overly punishing.
 Simplified Starter Deck Mechanics for smoother onboarding.


Plan

 More events.
 More cards for the first place character.
